description: World leaders spent UNGA week trading threats over Iran, Gaza and AI, and Reuters called it a week of no breakthroughs, while Delaware diesel hit a record $6.4466. I close with Dutch PM Rob Jetten's reminder that we don't have to wait another minute to change the world.

title: UNGA 81 Special Report: The World Talked War. Delaware Pays at the Pump. — Travis Jack Stevens for U.S. Senate
